title: Compatibility Facade Classification

rl/custom_ppo/latent_diagnostics.py.reason: Phase 7 facade re-exporting from diagnostics/ sub-modules. 5 active callers spanning production code and tests. Must remain permanently.

rl/custom_ppo/inference.py.reason: Re-exports load_custom_ppo_policy, load_custom_ppo_checkpoint, _expand_cnn_obs_channels. Active callers in experiments, analysis, tests, and checkpoint loader. Must remain permanently.

rl/custom_ppo/rollout_collector.py.reason: Re-exports RolloutCollector. Used by trainer (production) and 2 test files. Must remain permanently.

callers: tools/audit_refactor_progress.py (string literal only, not an import)
rl/custom_ppo/rollout/collector.py (docstring reference only, not an import)
rl/custom_ppo/rollout_step_recorder.py.reason: 6-line re-export of RolloutStepRecorder. Zero actual import-level callers found. Only appears as a string in an audit tool and a docstring comment. Safe to deprecate; can be removed after confirming no callers are added during Stage 14-15 work.

rl/presets/plan_faithful.py.reason: 193-line facade re-exporting all 91 plan-faithful preset functions from rl.presets.families.plan_faithful.*. 16 active callers in registry, family modules, and test suite. Must remain permanently.

gpu_env/_core/_state.py.reason: 54-line composition root that assembles _StateMixin from 12 sub-mixins. BatchedCTFCore inherits _StateMixin; this file is the permanent architectural seam between the sub-mixin package and the core class. Must remain permanently — it is the canonical definition of _StateMixin, not just a re-export.

rl/presets/compatibility.py.reason: 66-line facade re-exporting PresetRegistry, PresetError, etc. through rl.presets.__init__. Active path through __init__.py which is the public API. Must remain while the preset system is in use.

notes: rollout_step_recorder.py is the only candidate for eventual removal; confirm no new callers appear during Stage 14-15 before deleting.
gpu_env/_core/_state.py is classified ACTIVE_COMPATIBILITY but is more accurately described as the permanent composition root — it is never a transitional shim.
plan_faithful.py was refactored from 3302 to 193 lines in Phase 10; the facade is now the stable external-facing module with implementations in rl/presets/families/plan_faithful/.
